mapper.select: SELECT Xpn, UseYn, Updpn, UpdDate, Rgr, RgDate, Qee, Prams, NtnId, MenuPrntCd, MenuName, MenuCd, FileName, FileLct, DelPssYn, DedName FROM SYSM1000T WHERE MenuCd = #{menuCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sysm1000t (menucd, menuname, menuprntcd, filelct, filename, useyn, dedname) VALUES (#{menuCd}, #{menuName}, #{menuPrntCd}, #{fileLct}, #{fileName}, #{useYn}, #{dedName})
mapper.update: update sysm1000t set menuname = #{menuName}, menuprntcd = #{menuPrntCd}, filelct = #{fileLct}, filename = #{fileName}, dedName = #{dedName}, useyn = #{useYn} where menucd = #{menuCd}
mapper.delete: update sysm1000t set useyn = 'N' where menucd = #{menuCd}
